dishes.// dishEffects: Whether the exotic dishes apply their status effects at all. Turn this off on a server where the buffs are too strong; the dishes still feed you.
dishes.// dishDrawbacks: Whether the exotic dishes apply their DOWNSIDES. On by default, because the downside is what the buff is paid for; turning it off is a cheat switch.

rawFood.// rawMealSickness: Whether eating raw cuts one after another makes you sick. Every food in this mod can be eaten on a full hunger bar, and this is what pays for that.
rawFood.// rawMealWindow: Seconds after a raw cut during which the next one counts as part of the same binge. The first raw cut is always free; the second inside this window is not.

butchery.// extraMeatDrops: Whether Alex's Caves mobs that give no food of their own should drop a raw cut when killed. Turn this off to leave every loot table exactly as it was.
butchery.// extraMeatDropChance: Chance for one of those mobs to drop its cut, from 0 (never) to 1 (always).
butchery.// extraMeatDropMax: Largest number of cuts one of those mobs can drop. The actual count is a flat roll between one and this.
